title: Emilie: su figura y su retrato
description: docs/quests/emilie.md. Emilie's toy figure (just character-3d, tools/figures.toml [emilie]) in her flooded flat beside Gerard and Aitor, close up from the game's camera, her low-poly portrait in a conversation, and her bestiary entry front-on (she faces her window in the flat). Run uv run python tools/bestiary.py first so the figure's images show. Run it with --gpu.
